observation: Across saved matching receipts for three reported sources, 84 covered+grounded+duplicate judgments referenced proposed paragraphs: 56 new-only and 28 mixed old/new. These are observations across multiple attempts, not unique gaps or proven false positives; eligibility against original missing status was not established.
issue: The independent source/novelty/contradiction verifier only ran when a duplicate flag had mixed old/new support; new-only support never got that independent check.
change: Apply the same independent verifier to eligible duplicate-flagged new-only support; accept only grounded, materially novel, non-contradictory proposals that pass the existing match and final delivery gates.
tradeoff: May add one verification request for batches containing only new-only duplicate flags. This can recover genuine additions but is not guaranteed to reduce requests or improve real success.
local_tests: 234 related tests passed, including true duplicate, ungrounded, contradictory, novel, malformed-verifier and transport-failure cases for both support shapes.
limitations: No semantic inspection of historic private checklist statements was performed after automatic review rejected the normalization query; exact historic false-positive count and full-podcast acceptance remain unknown.
